name: customer-metrics-ticker
title: Customer Metrics Ticker
description: A high-impact KPI telemetry strip with animated values, trending badges, and verification timestamps.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Customer Metrics Ticker Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
